results.title: Certificate verification

limitations: Trust is evaluated against the certifi CA bundle, which may differ from operating-system and browser trust stores.

Passive configuration assessment; not a penetration test. Passing checks do not mean the site is secure.
Only the response status line and headers are inspected; the body is never read, so <meta> CSP and page content are not assessed.
TLS checks cover certificate verification and expiry only; protocol versions and cipher suites are not audited.
Trust is evaluated against the certifi CA bundle, which may differ from your operating system or browser trust store.
URL paths are reported as given and may contain tokens; query values are redacted.
